asleep.text: (Fast asleep. Best not to wake them.)
asleep.speaker: narrator

ribbon.text: The ribbon? Mum's blue one? ...I didn't take it. I saw a fox by our door the night before last, though. It had something in its mouth. I thought it was a rat. It was a very blue rat.

choices.text: Which way did the fox go?

ribbon2.text: South-east, towards the woods. Foxes den out by the heron pool, Hester says. Don't tell Mum I was up that late.

main.text: Hello! Do you want to see a nail I made? It's mostly straight.

nail.text: ...See? Mostly. Master Holt says 'mostly' is the most dangerous word in smithing.
